description.value: Himwitsa Lodge is an accommodation property in downtown Tofino operating under the House of Himwitsa complex, which also includes a First Nations art gallery and a smoked fish store. Located on Main Street, it sits at the heart of one of BC's most popular coastal destinations on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The lodge's affiliation with the Indigenous-owned House of Himwitsa gives it a culturally distinctive character compared to typical Tofino hotels.
